Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.label: Heal
Cosmere.System.Roshar.Def.SurgebindingAb.description: Push Stormlight into your wounds and let the light do its work. Cuts seal shut. Bruises fade. Broken bones grind back into place with a sensation that is not quite pain. Deeper injuries take longer, and the light demands more of itself to mend them.\n\nThis is not a miracle. It will not return what has been fully lost.
